note: Why our GSR pitch rung collapses (12.8 vs baseline 40.6). Our detected people matched to SoccerNet GT by image IoU >= 0.5; pitch error in metres. 2026-09-26.
findings: Error is a per-frame shared offset (whole projection shifted), not individual foot-point noise (1.5-3.3 m residual).
Roboflow's pitch template is not to scale (120x70 m, 20.15 m penalty box) but refitting to a true FIFA template gains only ~0.3-1.3 m.

Root cause: the pitch-keypoint model (football-field-detection-f07vi-it2xv/10) places landmarks confidently (conf 0.96-1.0) but up to ~14 m from their true positions on SoccerNet views (e.g. zoomed penalty-box view in SNGS-056); keypoints are inside the image, not out-of-frame guesses.

in_domain_check_hilal_ahli.what: Our keypoint model (football-field-detection-f07vi-it2xv/10, Roboflow hosted inference) on HILAL-AHLI frame 0 vs the hand-placed CVAT pitch-line points; the CVAT keyframes (frames 0-10) are all one camera view of the right penalty area.
in_domain_check_hilal_ahli.cvat_to_model_label_map: derived from the CVAT skeleton drawing and confirmed by the model's positions on frame 0: CVAT 1-11 -> 1-11, 13->12, 14->13, 15->14, 16->15, 17->16, 19->17, 20->18, 21->19, 23-35 -> 20-32; CVAT 12, 18, 22 (penalty-arc tops, centre spot) have no model landmark
in_domain_check_hilal_ahli.conclusion: In our camera setup the keypoint model is accurate on this view (~0.5 m); the SoccerNet pitch-rung collapse is a transfer failure to unseen broadcast setups. Only one view is annotated, so midfield views (few, near-collinear keypoints) remain unmeasured in-domain.
